episodes.ending: Episode 1 ends — but the door is still open. To be continued...
locations: The Lantern House Research Center & Museum

panels.narration: Morning at the Lantern House Research Center & Museum. The town is still waking up — but inside, the past is already awake.

lines.text: Simon says this inscription mentions a door that was never built.
Then let's see what the evidence says.
The inscription is real. And it points here — to the museum's lower hall.
These markings match the inscription. Same hand. Same era.
If the inscription is right, this machine was built to open a way — not just to show one.

panels.narration: A low hum fills the hall.

lines.text: It's... beautiful. And a little terrifying.
That's not a picture. That's a place.
The fragment knows this door. It belongs on the other side.
We go together. We test everything. And we come home together.

panels.narration: The Lantern House holds its breath.

episodes.subtitle: Episode 1 — A quiet morning at the Lantern House turns into the team's first step through the Gateway.
episodes.title: The Gateway Lights Up
